intro: Zero, the unknown keyblade wielder, walks the edges of every story. These are the worlds of the first game, each one a doorway into his own lore.

worlds.name: Traverse Town
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 1 - after Destiny Islands falls to the Heartless
worlds.why: Zero's first foothold in this worldline. The door between has dropped him here to learn the shape of the enemy.
worlds.story: Three districts, one lamp-lit hub. Zero arrives wearing the cloak of a Nobody, twin red blades drawn. The bell-hop urchins mistake him for a Heartless; the shopkeepers for a Nobody. But Ansem's first report is found here - the machine's earliest confession. Zero closes the district's hidden Keyhole and earns his first resonance.

worlds.name: Destiny Islands
worlds.timeline: KH1 Prologue - the world that fell first
worlds.why: Zero must witness the door's first wound. Where Sora lost the light, Zero finds the shape of his own duty.
worlds.story: A world already sunk into the dark by the time Zero arrives. He walks the tide-washed streets, finds the hidden cave where children drew their dreams, and pulls a shard of the Keyblade's light from the sand. This is where he understands: the Door to Darkness took this world, and it must be sealed - for all of them.
beats: the drawing of the Keyblade in the cave
take the shard of first light

worlds.name: Wonderland
worlds.why: A world where memory is a crime. Zero's own memory is fraying - the Shamblers steal it - and Wonderland teaches him to hold what he keeps.
worlds.story: The Queen's court runs on accusations and forgetting. Zero trails Alice's trial, using his shadow to slip the card soldiers. The Bizarre Room's keyhole hides behind a door that is also a mind. Zero closes it, and for a moment, remembers something that is not his own.
beats: off with her head - not today
a memory that is not yours

worlds.name: Olympus Coliseum
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 1 - the games of the gods
worlds.why: The arena where heroes are measured. Zero fights from the shadows so that Hercules can stand in the light.
worlds.story: Under the eyes of the gods, Zero fights the phantom bracket - Cloud's echo, Hades' schemes - never taking the credit. He wins a fragment of the god-games' valor and uses it to seal the coliseum's Keyhole. Hercules never sees his shadow-hero. Zero prefers it that way.

worlds.name: Deep Jungle
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 1 - the heart of the wild
worlds.why: Here Zero learns the language of hearts - the one thing no cloak can hide.
worlds.story: Tarzan speaks to the world, not in words. Zero follows the vine-walker to the temple where the Keyhole waits, and for the first time speaks as himself, not the shadow. The jungle's heart accepts the unknown wielder. The Keyhole closes with a kindness, not a blade.

worlds.name: Agrabah
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 2 - the cave of wonders
worlds.why: A diamond in the rough glitters only in the dark. Zero's own worth was only ever seen in shadow.
worlds.story: The Cave of Wonders holds a Keyhole that eats light. Zero moves as the cave's own shadow, past the treasure golems, and finds the lamp's true secret: a heart that chose freedom. He seals the Keyhole and leaves a single coin behind - the only treasure he has ever owned.

worlds.name: Monstro
worlds.why: A world inside a belly is a prison made of hunger. Zero knows that cage from the inside of his own cloak.
worlds.story: Pinocchio's heart is being carved into a puppet again. Zero navigates Monstro's dark ribs, finds the wooden boy, and closes a Keyhole that is also a stomach. The whale sneezes them free. Zero holds the fragment of the puppet's heart - real, despite being made.
beats: a made heart is still a heart

worlds.name: Atlantica
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 2 - the world under the wave
worlds.why: The Keyhole under the sea. Zero, who cannot breathe in most stories, learns to hold his breath in this one.
worlds.story: Ursula's cauldron is a Keyhole's cradle. Zero moves through the coral halls silent as pressure, frees Ariel's voice when it is swallowed, and turns the trident's light against the sea-witch. The Keyhole closes underwater, and Zero surfaces with salt he never knew he could taste.

worlds.name: Halloween Town
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 2 - the night before the fright
worlds.why: A town where everyone wears a mask. Zero's cloak finally fits in. But even here, the Heartless wear masks too.
worlds.story: Oogie Boogie's dice are loaded against the holiday. Zero slips between the jack-o-lanterns, undoes the Heartless trap under the hill, and lets Jack take his bow. The Keyhole is a doorway shaped like a grin. Zero closes it before it can laugh.

worlds.name: Neverland
worlds.timeline: KH1 Act 2 - the clock that never moves
worlds.why: Here Zero catches the first real trace of Sora - the boy the whole story turns on.
worlds.story: The clock tower holds a Keyhole in its hands. Zero follows the trail of a boy with a Keyblade who passed through this world moments ahead of him - the first proof Sora is alive. He frees the lost children, lets the shadows carry him over the sea, and seals the Keyhole with the smell of salt and stardust.

worlds.name: 100 Acre Wood
worlds.timeline: KH1 Secret world - the heart's quiet room
worlds.why: The one world that holds no Keyhole. Zero goes there to keep what little home he remembers.
worlds.story: Pooh's pages are a storybook, and the book is a heart. Zero helps the friends find their pages, and for one chapter he is not the unknown - he is just someone who walked in from the dark to play. It is the only world he visits for himself.

worlds.name: Hollow Bastion
worlds.timeline: KH1 Final Act - the heart of the machine
worlds.why: The lynchpin of Zero's lore. Here, inside Ansem's own fortress, the machine's memory reaches out - and a voice older than the door speaks from inside Zero's heart.
worlds.story: This world is a lie built on Ansem's guilt. Zero climbs the machine-heart and finds the study where the reports were written - the same voice that narrates his journey. And there, in the reflection of the Keyhole, he sees a face that is not his own: old eyes, a seeker's eyes. The twin red blades hum with a name he has never spoken. He seals the Keyhole, and for a moment the dark whispers: 'You were never alone in there, were you, Terra?'
beats: the reflection that is not your own
the whisper of an old name

worlds.name: End of the World
worlds.timeline: KH1 Final Act - the door to darkness
worlds.why: Where the first Door opens. Zero does not walk the light-path with the heroes - he walks the dark-path beside it, so the Door can be closed from both sides at once.
worlds.story: Fragments of worlds orbit a door. Zero crosses with Sora's party unseen, closing the last keyholes in the rubble. When Sora faces Ansem at the Door to Darkness, Zero is the shadow at the hinge, holding the dark side shut so the light can seal it. When the Door closes, Zero is left on the dark side of it - alone, as he has always been. Somewhere, Ansem's voice begins again: 'There is more. You have always been more.'
beats: hold the hinge while sora seals the door
left on the dark side of the door
